title: ReCharged
description: This project adds many thing as car, computer and batteries
body:
In this mod you can find:

Small battery, battery and big battery - depended on size, the block on which you right-click will be changed on charged block for: small - 1800 ticks, normal - 3600 ticks, big - 7200 ticks; and then it will turn into charge-ended block

Wheel - used to make a car

Car - new type of boat

Memory and Mainboard - items used to make a computer

WPc (computer and its turned off version) - has many uses: from medical care to credits, music and setting oxygen to maximum
